title: OpenMC Roleplay
description: OpenMC – Immersive Minecraft RP server with a custom modpack for long-term roleplay, economy, building, and living character interactions.
body:
OpenMC – Minecraft Roleplay Server

OpenMC is a dedicated Minecraft roleplay server focused on deep, immersive, and long-term storytelling. Built for players who enjoy character-driven narratives, city roleplay, and collaborative worldbuilding, OpenMC offers a welcoming community and a structured RP environment.

What makes OpenMC special:

Living city roleplay with shops, businesses, and player-run organizations

Character-driven storytelling with realistic interactions and consequences

A supportive community focused on creativity and immersion

Regular in-game events and evolving storylines

Custom server systems that enhance roleplay without breaking the vanilla feel

⚠️ Note: A custom modpack is required to join the server.
